# Which simulator better resembles real-world CGM?

This report measures each simulator's distance from real CGM
(OhioT1DM + ShanghaiT1DM + AZT1D) using the metric battery in
`diff/build_report.py`, without training anything. The yardstick is the distance
*between the real cohorts themselves* — a simulator inside that envelope is,
distributionally, as real as one real cohort is to another.

*Generated by `uva_padova/compare_realism.py`. Do not edit by hand.*

> **Caveat.** T1DMSIM was calibrated against OhioT1DM; UVA/Padova runs here on
> its own native data-generation stack
> (RandomScenario meals + BBController + Dexcom CGM). That calibration targeted both **level** and
> distributional *shape* (the ΔBG distribution and autocorrelation), so the
> **dynamic** metrics are not a fitting-free contest either — merely less
> dominated by the level fit.

| Cohort | Mean BG | GMI | TIR 70–180 | 5-min ΔBG SD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Real (pooled)** | 155 | 7.01 | 68% | 6.00 |
| · Ohio | 162 | 7.19 | 61% | 5.89 |
| · Shanghai (15-min) | 164 | 7.22 | 55% | — |
| · AZT1D | 147 | 6.83 | 78% | 6.02 |
| **T1DMSIM** | 163 | 7.20 | 61% | 5.51 |
| **UVA/Padova** | 120 | 6.19 | 93% | 4.01 |

## Distance to real (lower is closer)

Wasserstein-1 between each simulator's pooled distribution and real, with the
real-vs-real floor for reference:

| | T1DMSIM | UVA/Padova | real-vs-real floor |
|---|---|---|---|
| BG distribution | 13.7 | 30.0 | 18.4 |
| ΔBG distribution | 0.7 | 1.2 | 0.3 |

On the marginal BG distribution **T1DMSIM** is closer to real, by ≈2.2× on
Wasserstein.

## Per-metric distance (units of one real-patient SD)

A gap under 1.0 means the simulator's population mean lands within the spread of
real patients on that metric. The battery is split by **sampling cadence**:
marginal & risk metrics are cadence-invariant and referenced to all three real
cohorts; rate-of-change metrics are referenced only to the 5-min cohorts (Ohio,
AZT1D), since Shanghai is 15-min.

### Marginal & risk metrics (sampling-invariant; all three real cohorts)

| Metric | Real | T1DMSIM | UVA/Padova | ours (SD) | UVA (SD) | closer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mean BG | 154.6 | 162.6 | 120.5 | 0.34 | 1.44 | T1DMSIM |
| CV | 33.6 | 36.6 | 22.9 | 0.46 | 1.59 | T1DMSIM |
| TIR 70-180 | 67.8 | 60.9 | 93.5 | 0.42 | 1.58 | T1DMSIM |
| TBR 54-70 | 2.6 | 3.0 | 2.4 | 0.15 | 0.07 | UVA/Padova |
| TAR 180-250 | 21.0 | 26.4 | 3.0 | 0.54 | 1.80 | T1DMSIM |
| 10th pct | 92.2 | 90.9 | 85.9 | 0.08 | 0.39 | T1DMSIM |
| 90th pct | 224.6 | 244.5 | 157.8 | 0.53 | 1.79 | T1DMSIM |
| LBGI | 1.0 | 0.8 | 1.1 | 0.16 | 0.09 | UVA/Padova |
| HBGI | 6.4 | 7.6 | 1.3 | 0.35 | 1.39 | T1DMSIM |

Mean normalised error — T1DMSIM **0.34**,
UVA/Padova **1.13**.

### Rate-of-change metrics (cadence-dependent; 5-min cohorts only — the fairer test)

| Metric | Real | T1DMSIM | UVA/Padova | ours (SD) | UVA (SD) | closer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5-min ΔBG SD | 6.0 | 5.5 | 4.0 | 0.54 | 2.18 | T1DMSIM |
| MAGE | 82.9 | 99.0 | 47.7 | 0.86 | 1.89 | T1DMSIM |
| CONGA-1h | 37.9 | 38.9 | 24.5 | 0.18 | 2.41 | T1DMSIM |
| MODD | 45.8 | 63.2 | 22.1 | 1.53 | 2.08 | T1DMSIM |
| Sample entropy | 0.7 | 0.6 | 1.1 | 0.59 | 2.75 | T1DMSIM |

Mean normalised error — T1DMSIM **0.74**,
UVA/Padova **2.26**.

## Reading the result

A model trained on the source whose distribution is closer to real incurs less
covariate/label shift at deployment, so distance to real bounds — but does not
prove — transfer quality. T1DMSIM is closer on every aggregate here: on level
(mean normalised error 0.34 vs 1.13 real-patient SDs) and on
dynamics (0.74 vs 2.26). Its pooled BG-distance to real
(14 mg/dL) falls **below** the real-vs-real floor (18 mg/dL) — inside
the spread among the real cohorts themselves — whereas UVA/Padova
(30 mg/dL) sits outside it. The ordering also holds on the
excursion-amplitude metrics (MAGE, MODD). None of this is a transfer guarantee:
T1DMSIM was fit to OhioT1DM, so the result confirms the calibration rather than
crowning a winner.

## Reproducing

```bash
venv/bin/python uva_padova/compare_realism.py            # full
venv/bin/python uva_padova/compare_realism.py --quick    # fast smoke run
```
